channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Jerome Kersey | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Jerome Kersey from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Del Harris on Byron Scott, Jerome Kersey, Robert Horry
item.description:
Harris told The County Sun during shootaround.

“If it doesn’t work out, we’ll put Jerome Kersey in there. At this point, Jerome will be a backup, and we have to get him settled into that. And Byron Scott is a backup. Kobe knows when Robert’s back, he’ll go back (to coming off the bench).”

Del Harris on Byron Scott, Jerome Kersey, Robert Horry, Jan 28, 2022. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on Kevin Duckworth, Drazen Petrovic, Jerome Kersey, Cliff Robinson
item.description:
Ira Winderman:Erik Spoelstra on the death of Clifford Robinson,

“If you just look at that team, there's four players that are not with us anymore, starting with Drazen Petrovic, Kersey, Duckworth and now Cliff Robinson. I'm shocked. I'm stunned. And all you can do is send your prayers.”

Erik Spoelstra on Kevin Duckworth, Drazen Petrovic, Jerome Kersey, Cliff Robinson, Aug 29, 2020. Source: Twitter @IraHeatBeat.

item.title: Bernard King on Jerome Kersey, Darryl Dawkins, Pat Cummings
item.description:
“Moses, Darryl Dawkins, Jerome Kersey and before that Pat Cummings, just to name a few. And a lot of these guys have died of heart attacks. So I think it’s great that the league, the players association and the retired players association are joining forces to try and figure out why that is and what we can do to adequately provide for everyone.”

Bernard King on Jerome Kersey, Darryl Dawkins, Pat Cummings, Feb 28, 2016. Source: NBA.com.
